my husband passed away last November 2024, after a diagnosis of cancer December 2023. Prior to his diagnosis he had gone to the surgery repeatedly complaining of symptoms and his blood sugars being high, but this fell on deaf ears. He was given a book on diets and referred to the diabetes nurse. He continually pushed for a scan, but again nobody listened. Eventually one of the doctors sent him for a scan, we then found out he had cancer from the NHS app, before he had even seen a doctor - absolutely appalling! We had a really tough year and found it difficult to get support, before he was admitted to the hospice we requested a doctor to come and see him as he was really poorly, it took numerous phone calls requesting them to come and see him and even my daughter going to the surgery to ask, but was turned away with a flea in her ear, we put in the call at 8 a.m. and the doctor didn't come to see him until after 1p.m. How ill do you have to be?
